boundary_evidence: One function, SND_CalcChannelVolume, .text 0x0205b63c..0x0205b6b0, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt between SND_Work.cpp and SND_Bank.cpp.

NitroSDK SND_util.c shape: the same TU carries SNDi_DecibelTable and sVolumeTable, the two volume tables .rodata 0x02086384..0x02086758, matching the SDK source layout (pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/SND_util.c). SND_CalcChannelVolume indexes sVolumeTable; SoundEngine.cpp reads SNDi_DecibelTable cross-TU. The SM64DS SDK vintage writes -723 as the table's first entry where pokediamond's writes -32768.

rodata.evidence: const s16[128] SNDi_DecibelTable: the decibel scale SND volume arguments index, 0..-723 hundredths of a decibel below full scale
const u8[724] sVolumeTable: the channel volume byte and data shift SND_CalcChannelVolume reads, indexed by decibels + 723

notes: Hand-built manifest entry: the arm9 main module is unsegmentable, so tools/tubuild.py create has no candidate id for this range.
intact-object because the TU now owns the two .rodata volume tables; tu_production.prepare_intact_object re-verifies every licensed section against the cartridge before the link.

verification.flags: -O4,p -enum int -lang c99 -char signed -interworking -proc arm946e -gccext,on -msgstyle gcc -Cpp_exceptions off

linkcheck.round: tools/tubuild.py linkcheck -- scratch dsd delink+lcf, whole-tree mwccarm, mwldarm link, linked-range and module byte comparison, dsd check symbols --fail, full ROM build
